subject: Insurance
title: Insuring Against Ghosts
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Insuring Against Ghosts.

hook.text: A British company offers ghost insurance. If a supernatural entity causes injury or death, the policy pays £1 million.

buildup.text: Ultraviolet Consultancy sold over 2,000 ghost policies at £5-50 each. Buyers included homeowners near haunted sites.

discovery.text: No claim has ever been paid.

twist.text: Some paranormal investigators buy policies for legal protection.

climax.text: Ghost insurance is absurd but profitable. Selling protection against the impossible is pure premium with zero payouts.

punchline.text: £1 million for ghost damage, zero claims ever. Perfect business.

quiz.question: How many ghost insurance claims have been paid?
